description: Land Title Settlement Department - Koswatta Katana D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511200 (23/6128))
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extents, owners' names and addresses, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement matters, making it a clear example of Type 4 (Land Gazette).
